```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(vegan)

permanova_matrix <- load(here("Data", "permanova_matrix.Rdata")) #unscaled matrix
annotation_col <- load(here( "Data", "annotation_col.Rdata")) #metadata


#Z-score scale
scaled_permanova_matrix <- scale(permanova_matrix)

# K=11 was best model in lmer (see script called ED50_and_K_cluster_lmer)
group_permanova <- adonis2(scaled_permanova_matrix ~ K_11, 
                           data = annotation_col, 
                           method = "euclidean", 
                           permutations = 999)

print(group_permanova)

```
